year_mix.note: Selected year (latest recorded) per component from the pillar diagnostics year_provenance; index_components = variables of the variable decomposition; all_components adds sub-indices of composites. Every scored headline cell.

rankability_effects.note: pct_all = within-pair percentile among all scored economies (ok pairs); status = rankable / territory (not sovereign) / imputed share above tau only.

variance_decomposition.note: R2 of OLS of the pillar on dummies, pooled over the rankable cells of the ok pairs of the headline technologies (all_scored: every scored cell); within_pair_share = (RSS_pair - RSS_pair+country) / RSS_pair. es_comparison_rankable: the same for ES over its rankable cells of pairs with status ok.

contributions.note: Rankable cells only. mean_level_share: mean over the rankable cells of the stage of weighted_category_contribution / EO (absent categories count 0). mean_effective_weight: same mean of the renormalised category weight. mean_var_share: mean over the 11 pairs of the stage of cov(category contribution, EO) / var(EO) across the rankable economies of the pair; the shares sum to 1 within a stage. widest_pair_iqr_sources: for the three pairs with the widest IQR of EO, the IQR when one category's contribution is replaced by its pair mean. investment_coverage_by_pair: rankable economies with Investment observed or zero-filled.

input_weights.note: Effective weight of variable v in a country-cell = category_weight x component_weight_within_overall (sums to 1 per cell). Technology-level constant = zero range of component_value across the scored economies of the pair. Imputed = imputed flag of the variable contribution (missing-data rule applied). mean_level_share = mean of contribution / EO. by_stage / all_cells: rankable cells (the headline); *_all_scored: every scored cell.

leader_summary.emerging_definition: World Bank income group (data/raw/wdi_country_info.csv) in Low income, Lower middle income, Upper middle income

low_rank_detail_usa_china.note: Pairs with rank > n/2 among the rankable economies. category_pct / component_pct: within-pair percentile among the rankable economies, 1 = top. Components: country-varying variables only.

coalition.note: Rankable cells only. pct = within-pair percentile rank among the rankable economies, (n - average rank) / (n - 1), 1 = top; means are over rankable country-cells. Groups: Core / Partner (coalition_members tier), China, Other. mean_pct_cost = same percentile of the Cost Competitiveness category score. nominal_rate = the rate recorded in cost_competitiveness_tbl.rds (per cent) and its year; rate_rank_low_to_high ranks it among all economies with a recorded rate.
